description:
We are crossing Africa coast to coast, and today the road has other plans for us. Join us for our upcoming Lost Trip - SIGN UP here: https://forms.gle/Xk52Ezjx5Qwi5QtBA

After leaving Victoria Falls behind, we’re back on the road - but this time, we’re driving through relentless rain as we continue deeper into Africa toward Lost. What should have been another incredible day on the journey quickly turns into a battle with the weather, the roads and everything this continent can throw at us.

This is Episode 12 of Lost Way Round Africa - our mission to cross the African continent coast to coast and experience everything that happens along the way.
